GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.6 (29 Jan 46) CIS
(SCAPIN - 675)
APO 500
29 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Warrant Officer MATSUMOTO, Terushige.
1. Imperial Japanese Government will immediately apprehend Warrant officer, MATSUMOTO, Terushige, who is known to have used the alias "NAKAYAMA, Hisaichi", formerly connected with Kempei Headquarters in Shanghai.
2. MATSUMOTO embarked from Shanghai, 3 December 1945, aboard the Meiyu Maru.
3. MATSUMOTO's home address is reported to be 678 (or 679) Gondo, Fujiyama-Cho (or Kudo Yama-Mura) Ito Gun, Wakayama, Ken.
4. If the Imperial Japanese Government is unable to apprehend this individual detailed report of his whereabouts and the reason for non-arrest will be made immediately to this headquarters.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
